§6Electric Arc Furnace§f is the primary metal-processing multiblock in Advanced Rocketry. It smelts and alloys materials using high-power electrical arcs, running at 2x the speed of a vanilla furnace.

The multiblock is a 5x5x5 structure built from HeatProof Bricks with coils on the interior and Structure Towers. It needs continuous power, so hook it up to a serious RF generator.

Steel production is the main reason you build one: Iron + Coal in the Arc Furnace yields Steel Ingots. Titanium alloy and carbon smelting also happen here.

§cWARNING:§f The Arc Furnace does not produce experience like a vanilla furnace. All that XP goes nowhere.

§ePS:§f Pair with Item IO Circuit Boards on the inner faces for automated input/output.
